note: v2.8: (1) the Square fill now prefers the FOCUSED field, then a field inside the composer dialog/modal, over the old inline "Bạn đang nghĩ gì?" box on the feed. (2) capturePostUrl() only returns a URL when the page itself navigated to /square/post/<id>; it NEVER scrapes a link from the feed (a stale 2026-11-15 feed post was once falsely reported as the new Hyperliquid post). (3) After the Post click the leg waits 2s and re-checks: if a composer field is back holding a substantial part of the job text, the draft was restored and the post did NOT publish (FAILED "composer reopened with draft") instead of a false POSTED. The v2.7 Post-button composer-open and v2.6 article-composer refusal are unchanged.
